description: Rust-native Minecraft world storage: content-addressed section dedup + zstd container. v0.9.53: the POI store is a derived index — CSAVES_POI_ELIDE=1 turns it into a bounded session scratchpad, 0 B persisted (vanilla rebuilds from block states on load); 262k-chunk world: region-assert tier 34 KiB + elided poi -> 65.0 KiB total vs 1069.0 MiB Anvil region+poi (x0.000059, -99.994%). v0.9.54 THE PROVEN ASSERT: the scale probe gains the seed-verification gate — every chunk on disk is canonically hash-compared against the seed regeneration (canonical_contract_hash: order-free, strip-invariant; NBT byte order is NOT stable across serializations and real vanilla JVM map order is not either — content is what the tier guarantees) before any tier may claim reproducibility, the surviving legends are checked through the container against the same seed hashes (262144/262144 verified + 261888/261888 legend truths per CI run), and the divergent-chunk gate proves the negative: a chunk whose content diverged from the seed is caught by the classifier, refused the assert and stored honestly through the not-fresh evidence path (write_chunk_fresh fresh=false, the v0.9.47 gate) — nothing lost, nothing silently reverted to seed content; the restore identity pins 262143 seed-restored + 1 container-stored = 262144/262144 restored, 0 lost.
